about_the_game:
Play as Neli, a young supernaturalist who has been entrusted with a strange nature reserve full of surprises. You will meet the many characters who inhabit this remote place and discover their endearing personalities. Who knows—maybe you will manage to make friends with these complete strangers?

Take care of the neglected and polluted nature reserve until nature gradually reclaims its rights. Sow seeds, maintain complex ecosystems, and transform polluted and deserted lands into lush havens of peace.

Discover the secrets of a fantastic and magical world populated by mysterious creatures. Learn about each monster's behavior, adapt the reserve to their needs, and explore the nature park and its unusual corners.

Relax in welcoming landscapes and take the time to admire the areas you have cared for. Use your device to take the most beautiful pictures of the creatures you encounter. Create and share your photo album filled with customizable images.

short_description: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.
